candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the student position in Data Science. Reading, cleaning and analysing data with Python, and building models that support real decisions, is what I enjoy most, and helping cities plan the energy transition is a purpose I would be proud to work for.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked with production and business data as a Business Analyst and in SAP data consulting.

achievements.impact: I preprocessed image data (denoising, resizing, augmentation) and fine-tuned an EfficientNet-B0 that reached 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
I built DocuMind, a Python application with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker, and an evaluation that traced every failure to its cause
I rebuilt a manufacturer's dashboard end to end covering OEE, machine efficiency, downtime and yield, and validated data with SQL

letter.problems_section: I would read, clean and analyse data sets, apply statistical and machine learning methods, and help build and validate energy models. Energy system modelling is new to me, and I would learn it from your team while contributing solid Python and data skills.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Freiburg and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
